### Changed
- **The installation's skills credential is never a tenant's credential.** agent-manager mints it as `agent-manager-skills-token`, the installation's own name outside the `tenant-credential-` prefix; `agent-platform-tenant-credential-refs` refuses it in every Organization namespace under each of its names (`agent-manager.skills.gitAuthSecretName` or the minted Secret, and their earlier names, `tenant-credential-agent-manager-skills-token` included), as a git `credentialRef` or a `headersFrom` Secret, for every requester. The platform's agents keep naming it in the `kagent` namespace. The connectivity chart's `agent-manager migrate` run moves every agent naming `tenant-credential-agent-manager-skills-token` to `agent-manager-skills-token`, which agent-manager keeps filled; the earlier Secret stays filled until no agent names it. `make verify-migration` and `make verify-tenant-rbac` assert both.
